StowMind 1.1 introduces a safety-first iPhone Home Screen organizer and expands local AI support.

- Added full Home Screen page inventory through Apple iPhone Mirroring, with strict checks that prevent partial scans from creating a global organization plan.
- Added native high-frame-rate mirroring preview and a companion interaction mode that keeps the real Apple mirroring window usable without embedding or covering it.
- Added protected planning and assisted execution for moving Apps, with confidence thresholds, window verification, small batches, pause/cancel controls, and a non-disableable rule that never deletes, uninstalls, hides, or removes Apps.
- Added local Codex CLI and Claude Code providers alongside Ollama, OpenAI, and Claude API options.
- Added clear scan failure details and direct rescan actions after failed, paused, or cancelled iPhone organization sessions.
- Fixed Home Screen inventory starting from the second page, long-running scans blocking other app work, and status pages switching between live and empty data.
- Improved cleanup scan diagnostics and retry guidance.

Permissions: iPhone inventory needs Screen Recording so StowMind can read the Apple mirroring window. Scanning all Home Screen pages and assisted moves also need Accessibility. After granting either permission, restart StowMind if macOS does not recognize the change immediately.
